stemMd: A technician cuts a 3 m cable into equal pieces of 25 cm without waste. How many pieces result?
explanationMd: Convert three metres to 300 centimetres. Divide by 25 centimetres per piece: 300/25=12. This asks for pieces, not the number of cuts.

distractorRationale.a: This uses an incorrect conversion or piece length.
distractorRationale.d: This multiplies unlike length units instead of dividing.
distractorRationale.e: This introduces an extra factor of ten.
